inductive crostalk noise is more significant for global interconnects, and the effect of self-inductance is more than the mutual-inductance.
the inductive coupling effect is more significant for long interconnect and it has more impact on signal integrity and overall performance of the circuit.
the effect of mutual inductive coupling for local interconnect is almost negligible but it is very significant for global interconnect and self inductance has more effect on crosstalk.
